name: rustcraft
description: A cross-platform voxel sandbox built in Rust, featuring procedural worlds, multiplayer, modding, and software/WGPU rendering.
long_description: Runtime support and testing vary by platform; a build script or CI compile does not imply validation on every device. RustCraft includes a multithreaded CPU software rasterizer, a WGPU hardware renderer, and a PlayStation Vita GXM renderer.
